positive_snippets: Hotel Pink offers good service and responds quickly. Rooms are small but neat and clean. Only the stairs are not good for the old ages. You won’t face any issues with blankets or hot water. The rates for AC and non-AC rooms are the same. Food, tea, etc. are available at the hotel, but they’re charged separately. The hotel is located right in front of New Delhi Station. There are plenty of other hotels and food stalls in the area. Your safety is in your own hands.

​"Had an excellent stay here! The room was spotless, modern, and surprisingly quiet given the central location. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, and the breakfast spread was delicious with plenty of variety. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Delhi!"

1) Hotel is Near Station Area.(But in crowded and small lane)
2) Rooms are Small (Neat and Clean)
3) No Separate Geyser (Hot water is made available through common Boiler whenever required)
4) Staff is cooperative.
5) Slightly Expensive ( I was charged Rs 2000 for a room, with a Big + small bed for 2 Adults + 2 Children.
6) Mobile Network Coverage very poor. (Wifi with good speed is available)
